location.zh: 港景飯店，整修中的大廳

goal.en: Tell a client about a shipping delay and offer a plan.
goal.zh: 告知客戶出貨延遲，並提出應變方案。

background: grand hotel lobby under renovation, marble floor partly covered with protective sheets, ladders, empty ceiling fixture mounts, tall arched windows, stacked plain cardboard boxes, morning light

intro.en: The Harborview Hotel signed with Brightway. But this morning, the factory called: the new lobby lights will arrive two weeks late.
intro.zh: 港景飯店和 Brightway 簽約了。但今天早上工廠來電：新的大廳燈具會晚兩週到貨。

intro.en: Bad news doesn't get better with age, Kai. Tell her today, in person, and bring a plan.
intro.zh: 壞消息放越久只會越糟，凱。今天就當面告訴她，而且要帶著方案去。

lines.en: Kai! Come in. I hope you're here to tell me the new lobby lights are right on schedule.
lines.zh: 凱！請進。希望你是來告訴我，新的大廳燈具一切照進度。

choices.en: I'm afraid I have some bad news. The shipment has been delayed by about two weeks.
choices.zh: 恐怕我有個壞消息。這批貨會延遲大約兩週。
choices.tip: I'm afraid I have some bad news. 先給對方心理準備，再直接說重點。

choices.en: Ha ha, about that... The weather is really nice today, isn't it? And your lobby is looking great.
choices.zh: 哈哈，關於這個……今天天氣真好，對吧？您的大廳看起來很棒。

lines.en: The weather? Kai, what aren't you telling me?
lines.zh: 天氣？凱，你有什麼沒告訴我的？

story.en: Avoiding the news only makes it sound worse. Ms. Grant starts imagining that the factory has burned down.
story.zh: 逃避壞消息只會讓它聽起來更糟。葛蘭特總監開始想像工廠是不是燒掉了。

fail.why: 傳達壞消息時拐彎抹角聊天氣，會讓對方更不安，也更不信任你。直接、溫和地說：I'm afraid I have some bad news.。

choices.en: Very sorry, there is a small problem happened. The goods cannot arrive on time, maybe.
choices.zh: 很抱歉，發生了一個小問題。貨可能沒辦法準時到。

lines.en: A small problem? Maybe? Can they arrive on time or not?
lines.zh: 小問題？可能？到底能不能準時到？

story.en: Ms. Grant has to ask four questions to get one clear answer. Her patience runs out before your explanation does.
story.zh: 葛蘭特總監問了四個問題才得到一個明確答案。你還沒解釋完，她的耐心先用完了。

fail.why: there is 和 happened 不能同時用，要說 A problem has come up.；結尾加 maybe 也讓訊息更模糊。壞消息要清楚：The shipment has been delayed by about two weeks.。

lines.en: Two weeks? We reopen the lobby in ten days. How did this happen?
lines.zh: 兩週？我們十天後大廳就要重新開幕了。怎麼會這樣？

choices.en: Our supplier's factory had a power outage, which held up production. We should have warned you sooner.
choices.zh: 我們供應商的工廠停電，耽誤了生產。我們應該更早通知您的。
choices.tip: 簡短說明原因，再用 We should have... 承擔沒及早通知的責任。

choices.en: It's not really our fault. The factory messed up, so you should complain to them, not us.
choices.zh: 這其實不是我們的錯。是工廠搞砸的，所以您應該去跟他們抱怨，不是找我們。

lines.en: I don't have a contract with the factory, Kai. I have one with you.
lines.zh: 我跟工廠沒有合約，凱。我的合約是跟你們簽的。

story.en: Ms. Grant reminds you who her contract is with. Ms. Wong reminds you again in the car.
story.zh: 葛蘭特總監提醒你她的合約是跟誰簽的。回程車上，王經理又提醒了你一次。

fail.why: 對客戶來說，供應商的問題就是你的問題，推給工廠只會顯得不負責任。說明原因後承擔責任：We should have warned you sooner.。

choices.en: Sorry, I can't really say the reason. It's our company's internal matter, so it's not convenient to tell you.
choices.zh: 抱歉，原因我不太方便說。這是我們公司的內部事務，不方便透露。

lines.en: Not convenient? It's very inconvenient for my hotel.
lines.zh: 不方便？對我的飯店來說才是非常不方便。

story.en: Your secrecy makes Ms. Grant suspect something much worse. She asks her assistant to call two other lighting companies.
story.zh: 你的保密讓葛蘭特總監懷疑事情更嚴重。她請助理打電話給另外兩家照明公司。

fail.why: 「不方便透露」在台灣是常見的婉拒，但西方客戶遇到延誤時期待透明的說明，含糊帶過會讓人更不信任。簡單說明原因：Our supplier's factory had a power outage.。

lines.en: So what am I supposed to do? I can't open a five-star lobby in the dark.
lines.zh: 那我該怎麼辦？我不能在一片漆黑中開幕五星級大廳。

choices.en: Here's what we can do. We'll install temporary fixtures free of charge, so you can open on time.
choices.zh: 我們可以這樣做：免費安裝臨時燈具，讓您準時開幕。
choices.tip: Here's what we can do. 把話題從問題轉向解決方案，讓客戶看到出路。

choices.en: Don't worry, we will think of a way. When the boat reaches the bridge, it will go straight naturally.
choices.zh: 別擔心，我們會想辦法的。船到橋頭自然直。

lines.en: The boat... and the bridge? Kai, I need lights, not riddles.
lines.zh: 船……和橋？凱，我需要的是燈，不是謎語。

story.en: Ms. Grant stares at you, waiting for a plan. Ms. Wong quietly opens her folder and presents one.
story.zh: 葛蘭特總監盯著你，等你提出方案。王經理默默打開資料夾，把方案拿了出來。

fail.why: 「船到橋頭自然直」直譯成英文沒人聽得懂，而且客戶要的是具體方案，不是安慰。說 Here's what we can do. 再提出做法。

choices.en: Don't worry! I promise the real lights will arrive before then. I'll personally make sure of it.
choices.zh: 別擔心！我保證正式的燈會在那之前到。我會親自確保。

lines.en: But you just told me they're two weeks late. Which is it?
lines.zh: 可是你剛剛才說會晚兩週。到底是哪個？

story.en: Ms. Grant holds you to your promise. Ten days later, the lights are still on a ship somewhere at sea.
story.zh: 葛蘭特總監把你的承諾記下來了。十天後，燈還在海上的某艘船裡。

fail.why: 為了安撫客戶而承諾做不到的事，只會讓下一次失望更大。提出實際可行的方案：Here's what we can do. We'll install temporary fixtures.。

lines.en: Temporary fixtures... Will my guests be able to tell the difference?
lines.zh: 臨時燈具……我的房客看得出差別嗎？

choices.en: Honestly, a little, up close. But we'll match the color and brightness, so the overall feel stays the same.
choices.zh: 老實說，近看會有一點差別。但我們會配合顏色和亮度，讓整體感覺不變。
choices.tip: 誠實說出限制，再說明你會怎麼降低影響，比一味說「完全沒差」可信。

choices.en: No, they can't. The temporary lights is almost same as the real one, just a little bit cheap.
choices.zh: 看不出來。臨時燈跟正式的幾乎一樣，只是比較便宜一點。

lines.en: A little bit cheap? That's not a word I want in my lobby.
lines.zh: 有點廉價？我可不希望大廳跟這個詞扯上關係。

story.en: Ms. Grant now pictures plastic lamps in her marble lobby. You spend ten minutes trying to un-say one word.
story.zh: 葛蘭特總監現在腦中浮現大理石大廳裡的塑膠燈。你花了十分鐘想收回那個字。

fail.why: lights 是複數，動詞用 are；「幾乎一樣」是 almost the same as。cheap 當形容詞常有「廉價」的意思，說 less expensive 比較好。

choices.en: By the way, those temporary ones are on sale right now. Would you like to just buy them instead?
choices.zh: 對了，那些臨時燈具現在正在特價。您要不要乾脆直接買下來？

lines.en: Instead of the lights I already paid for? No, thank you.
lines.zh: 取代我已經付錢的那批燈？不用了，謝謝。

story.en: Ms. Grant wonders whether the delay is real or just a sales trick. Ms. Wong spends the afternoon proving it is real.
story.zh: 葛蘭特總監開始懷疑延遲是真的，還是推銷的手段。王經理花了一下午證明它是真的。

fail.why: 傳達壞消息時趁機推銷，會讓客戶懷疑你的動機。誠實回答對方的問題：Honestly, a little, up close. But we'll match the color.。

lines.en: All right. I'm not happy, but I appreciate you telling me in person.
lines.zh: 好吧。我並不開心，但很感謝你當面告訴我。

choices.en: I understand, and I'm sorry for the trouble. I'll update you every Monday until everything is installed.
choices.zh: 我理解，造成您的困擾很抱歉。在全部安裝完成前，我每週一都會向您回報進度。
choices.tip: 道歉之後承諾固定回報的時間，讓客戶覺得一切仍在掌握之中。

choices.en: To say sorry, please let us invite you to a big dinner. And please accept this small gift too.
choices.zh: 為了表示歉意，請讓我們請您吃頓大餐。也請收下這份小禮物。

lines.en: That's kind, but I can't accept gifts from suppliers. Company policy.
lines.zh: 謝謝好意，但我不能收供應商的禮物。這是公司規定。

story.en: You carry the gift back to the office. It now sits on Sam's desk, unopened.
story.zh: 你把禮物帶回公司。它現在擺在山姆桌上，還沒拆開。

fail.why: 在台灣送禮請客賠罪很常見，但許多西方企業規定採購人員不能收供應商的禮物，以免有利益衝突。用行動彌補更好：I'll update you every Monday.。

choices.en: Great, so we're good then? I was so worried you would shout at me today.
choices.zh: 太好了，所以我們沒事了吧？我好擔心您今天會對我大吼。

lines.en: We're not "good" yet, Kai. We'll be good when my lobby is lit.
lines.zh: 我們還沒「沒事」，凱。等我的大廳亮起來才算沒事。

story.en: Ms. Grant's polite smile disappears. You realize the problem is not solved just because the hard part of the talk is over.
story.zh: 葛蘭特總監禮貌的笑容消失了。你這才發現，難開口的部分講完了，不代表問題已經解決。

fail.why: 客戶還在不高興時就急著確認「沒事了吧」，顯得只在乎自己的感受。用具體的後續行動結尾：I'll update you every Monday until everything is installed.。

lines.en: Every Monday. Good. I'd rather hear bad news from you early than late.
lines.zh: 每週一，很好。比起太晚知道，我寧願早點從你這裡聽到壞消息。

lines.en: Thank you for understanding, Ms. Grant. We won't let you down on the reopening.
lines.zh: 謝謝您的體諒，葛蘭特總監。重新開幕我們絕不會讓您失望。

story.en: Ten days later, the lobby opens on time under the temporary lights. Nobody notices, except Ms. Grant, who sends you a thank-you note.
story.zh: 十天後，大廳在臨時燈具下準時開幕。沒有人察覺，只有葛蘭特總監注意到了，還寄了一張感謝卡給你。

notes.en: I'm afraid I have some bad news.
notes.explain: I'm afraid 讓壞消息聽起來比較委婉，也給對方一點心理準備。說完就直接講重點，不要拐彎抹角。

example.en: I'm afraid I have some bad news. The meeting room is no longer available.
example.zh: 恐怕我有個壞消息，會議室不能用了。

notes.explain: 說完壞消息後，用這句把焦點轉向解決方案。客戶最在意的通常不是原因，而是接下來怎麼辦。

example.en: Here's what we can do. We'll ship half the order this week.
example.zh: 我們可以這樣做：本週先出一半的貨。

notes.en: We should have warned you sooner.
notes.zh: 我們應該更早通知您的。
notes.explain: should have + 過去分詞 表示「過去應該做卻沒做」，用來承擔責任很自然，比一再說 sorry 更有誠意。

example.en: I should have checked the date more carefully.
example.zh: 我應該更仔細確認日期的。

notes.en: It's not convenient to tell you.
notes.explain: 這是中文婉拒的直譯，英文聽起來像在隱瞞。真的不能說時用 I'm not able to share the details, but here's what I can tell you.。

example.en: I can't share every detail, but here's what happened.
example.zh: 細節我沒辦法全部透露，但大致情況是這樣。

notes.explain: 許多西方企業規定員工不能收供應商的禮物或招待，以免有利益衝突。彌補客戶最好的方式是具體行動與定期回報。

example.en: I'll send you an update every Monday morning.
example.zh: 我每週一早上都會寄進度給您。
